files.purpose: Three-cell heroine outfit sprite sheet: Frost Gown, Flame Dress, Spark Suit
Three-cell mannequin invader sprite sheet: flame-weak, frost-weak, spark-weak
Four-cell HUD icon strip: flame, frost, spark, heart
390x844 portrait gameplay and HUD layout reference

style: Polished original vertical-comic linework with soft cel shading, plum contours, cream runway surfaces, and glamorous jewel-tone couture. Refined rose-gold HUD trim keeps gameplay readable over the boutique scene.
integration: Slice sprites/heroine.png into three 256x256 cells in order: Frost Gown, Flame Dress, Spark Suit.
Slice sprites/enemies.png into three 128x128 cells in order: flame-weak, frost-weak, spark-weak.
Slice sprites/icons.png into four 64x64 cells in order: flame, frost, spark, heart.
Use ui/hud-mock.png as the 390x844 layout reference: score left, Style Streak centered, three hearts right, heroine lower-middle, and three outfit buttons in the lower-third thumb zone.

For idle, show the selected outfit at rest; for a correct match, pop the Style Streak badge and selection glow; for a wrong match, reset the badge to x1 and remove one heart; for game over, dim gameplay and place a centered restart panel without moving the lower controls.

Apply the weakness cycle exactly: Frost Gown beats flame, Spark Suit beats frost, and Flame Dress beats spark. Keep each outfit button at least 56 px and all critical HUD content inside mobile safe areas.
